title: Side Path — Strategic Defense
purpose: Extend IC2 heavy industry into radar, launch control, conventional missiles, and defensive deterrence without bypassing nuclear or AI progression.

milestones.title: Build an IC2 Launch-Control Site
milestones.capability: Construct an ICBM launcher base and control screen from IC2 MV/HV infrastructure, steel, computers, and control processors.
final_validation: Craft an ICBM Launcher Pad and Launcher Screen using the IC2 integration recipes.
Supply converted IC2 EU through the installed 8:1 compatibility bridge.
Place the site far enough from settlements to operate safely.

milestones.title: Commission Missile-Defense Radar
milestones.capability: Add an IC2-powered radar station that detects missile threats and supports defensive launch decisions.
final_validation: Craft and place an ICBM Radar Station.
Connect it to the launch-control site and converted IC2 EU.
Configure detection and trigger ranges without targeting civilian settlements.

milestones.title: Field a Conventional Missile
milestones.capability: Assemble a non-nuclear conventional missile and verify launch control without unlocking nuclear, antimatter, or red-matter shortcuts.
final_validation: Assemble one conventional ICBM missile through the permitted industrial component chain.
Load it into the IC2-powered launcher and verify target controls in a safe test range.
Keep nuclear and exotic payloads out of this conventional defense program until their later controlled research is complete.
